title: RankingResult v1
description: Result of rank.compute: nodes ordered by their externally computed belief posterior (descending; ties by evidence_count descending, then stable input order). Nodes excluded from the ordering are reported explicitly in skipped_nodes.

title.description: The node's rationale_draft.title (sanitized), so a ranking is human-readable without a per-node second lookup.

tie_group_id.description: Present when this row belongs to a tie group (complete sort key equal to its neighbours): within-group order is stable input order only and carries no preference information.

ranked_nodes.description: May be empty when no node carries a posterior yet.

suggested_discriminator.description: Members are adjacent-posterior pairs at distance zero — the designed most-informative input for a pairwise comparison.

tie_groups.description: Groups of adjacent rows whose complete sort key (posterior_value, evidence_count) is bit-for-bit equal. Omitted when no ties exist. Rows equal only on posterior_value are not grouped: the evidence_count tiebreak is informative.

skipped_nodes.description: Nodes excluded from the ordering, reported explicitly instead of being silently dropped.

store_digest.description: Canonical digest (RFC 8785 + sha256) over the ranking-relevant projection of the filtered store plus the filter — stored values only, never recomputed quantities. Binds this ranking to the exact store state it ordered.

unchanged_since.description: Present when the store projection was unchanged since the campaign's recorded last ranking: ranking_artifact_ref points at that existing artifact (no new artifact minted, no step consumed) and this is its generated_at.
